notes.title: Skateboard Knight to be Published by PLAYISM!
notes.notes:
Casually save the world on a skateboard!

PLAYISM is proud to announce that we will be publishing Skateboard Knight, the action RPG-esque roguelite by Maroru Games!

[previewyoutube=ngvJGwLI6Aw;full][/previewyoutube]
The controls are simple: just move up and down to pick a lane. Horizontal movement and attacks are all automatic!

Please wishlist the game and look forward to future announcements for this laid back but surprisingly deep action RPG-esque roguelite!

We also have a demo here on Steam, so please try it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3196560/Skateboard_Knight_Demo/
